purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Ezhou, China.
assessment: Ezhou's official municipal bureau and Real Estate Registration Center document cadastral-map visualization and parcel query through Hubei government services, the Ezhou online service hall, app, and WeChat. The online service host currently returned an nginx default page, and the linked Hubei GreatMap host timed out. No anonymous parcel feature API, schema, CRS, safe native ID, or geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custodian verified: 鄂州市自然资源和城乡建设局 / 鄂州市不动产登记中心, evidenced by first-party notices describing Ezhou cadastral-map maintenance and public query procedures.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ezhou municipal natural-resources bureau portal. Current response is a maintenance page, but it is the first-party host for the registration-center materials.
Official notice says citizens, legal persons, and organizations can use listed government-service channels for Ezhou cadastral-map visualization; it does not expose anonymous GIS service metadata.
Official implementation plan describes identity-verified visualization and parcel query concepts, including parcel fields, but no public endpoint or anonymous response.
Officially advertised Ezhou online service hall URL; bounded anonymous GET returned an nginx default page rather than the cadastral viewer.
